description: libdc1394 is a cross-platform C library that provides a complete API for controlling IEEE 1394 (FireWire) cameras conforming to the IIDC/DCAM specification, covering camera detection, feature control, triggering, and video capture. This JavaCPP Presets module generates Java bindings for the native libdc1394 library, letting JVM applications control these cameras directly through JNI without writing custom native-interop code.
